notes: English identifies Brownie/Brownies as a recurring creature species: it is described as ferocious in groups, having teeth, being trained as a pet, and explicitly as monsters. Japanese ブラウニー and Chinese 棕矮妖 support the same creature in all 73 exact source keys. Register the species as monster:brownie and use 브라우니(Brownie) or 브라우니(Brownies) according to the English number. Six exact strings are excluded from the species span: Door to Brownie, the previously uncertain Brownie sauce (D-2378), Brownie's Bite (D-8416), the separately registered Pestilent Brownie subtype, and the two separately registered The Brownie Den title rows. Those existing findings and all other row/entity dispositions are preserved. The official Korean manual has no direct Brownie entry.
